title: Harness session summary
description: Schema for kpis/data/raw/sessions/<harness>/<sessionId>.summary.json: per-session usage, cost and outcome derived from the transcript by the ingest script. Field names follow OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (gen_ai.*) where one exists and say so; counts without an OTel attribute are Maxwell-specific. Claude Code message.usage and OpenCode tokens objects are both mapped onto the same tokens shape

sessionId.description: Harness session id; matches the sibling .meta.json

harness.description: Harness that ran the session and whose transcript format was parsed

harnessVersion.description: Harness release the session ran on (copied from the sibling .meta.json when it carries one, else from the transcript)

runId.description: Headless run the session belongs to; omitted for interactive sessions

companyId.description: Company the workflow ran for, when any

startedAt.description: Timestamp of the first transcript record

endedAt.description: Timestamp of the last transcript record

durationMs.description: endedAt minus startedAt in milliseconds (Claude Code cost-state totalDuration when present)

apiDurationMs.description: Time spent waiting on model API calls (Claude Code cost-state totalAPIDuration); omitted when the harness does not report it

turns.description: Assistant messages after dedup, i.e. distinct assistant turns in the main session

inferenceCalls.description: Distinct model invocations after dedup, including subagents. No OTel attribute; Maxwell-specific count

toolCalls.description: Tool invocations across the session with a per-tool breakdown. No OTel attribute; Maxwell-specific count

total.description: Total tool_use blocks after dedup; equals the sum of byTool values

byTool.description: Map of tool name to call count. Keys are tool names as they appear in tool_use blocks; capped at 256 distinct tools

subagentSessions.description: Number of distinct sidechain agents (Claude Code isSidechain records grouped by agent, OpenCode child sessions) spawned by the session

permissionDenials.description: Tool calls refused by the harness permission system; empty when none

models.description: Usage per model observed in the session (Claude Code message.model; OpenCode modelID and providerID on the assistant message); at least one entry. The model + provider pair is unique across entries: one entry aggregates every call of that pair

costUsd.description: Session cost in USD: what Maxwell computed from the pricing table versus what the harness itself reported. deltaPct is null exactly when reported is null or zero

computed.description: Sum of models[].costUsd, computed from token counts and the pricing table

reported.description: Harness-reported total (Claude Code total_cost_usd or cost-state totalCostUSD; OpenCode sum of message cost); null when the harness reported none

deltaPct.description: 100 * (computed - reported) / reported; null when reported is null or zero

pricingVersion.description: asOf date of the pricing table used to compute costs

dedup.description: How duplicate transcript records were collapsed before counting. Claude Code writes several records per requestId (streaming); the one with the largest total token count is kept

strategy.description: Dedup algorithm identifier; only one is defined

duplicatesDropped.description: Number of assistant records discarded as duplicates

filesWritten.description: Workspace files created or modified by Write/Edit tool calls during the session

linesAdded.description: Lines added across filesWritten (Claude Code cost-state totalLinesAdded)

linesRemoved.description: Lines removed across filesWritten (Claude Code cost-state totalLinesRemoved)

outcome.description: How the session ended: normal completion, an unrecoverable error, the max-turns or max-budget limit, or an operator abort

errors.description: Errors surfaced during the session; may be empty or omitted

transcriptFormatVersion.description: Transcript format version parsed. Claude Code: the 'version' field on transcript records, which equals harnessVersion because the CLI writes its own version on every record. OpenCode: the version of the `opencode export` format, which can lag the CLI release in harnessVersion

modelId.description: Alias of common modelId, kept for existing $refs

provider.description: Alias of common genAiProvider, kept for existing $refs

toolName.description: Tool name as it appears in tool_use blocks, e.g. 'Bash', 'Read', 'mcp__github__create_issue'

tokens.description: Token usage summed over all inference calls for one model after dedup. Claude Code message.usage: input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens, cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens; older records that only carry an undifferentiated cache_creation_input_tokens are booked as cacheWrite5m; the Anthropic usage object has no reasoning breakdown, so thinking is null. OpenCode tokens: input, output, cache.write (as cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h = 0), cache.read, reasoning (as thinking)

cacheWrite5m.description: Prompt-cache write tokens billed at the 5-minute TTL rate

cacheWrite1h.description: Prompt-cache write tokens billed at the 1-hour TTL rate

thinking.description: Reasoning tokens, a subset of output (gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens when the harness reports them: OpenCode tokens.reasoning). null when the harness does not report reasoning tokens (Claude Code), which is distinct from 0 (reported and none used)

modelUsage.description: Usage and cost for one model within the session

webSearchRequests.description: Server-side web search requests (message.usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests), billed per request

webFetchRequests.description: Server-side web fetch requests (message.usage.server_tool_use.web_fetch_requests), when the harness reports them

costUsd.description: USD cost for this model computed from the pricing table at pricingVersion

permissionDenial.description: A tool call the harness refused under its permission rules

toolUseId.description: Id of the denied tool_use block (Claude Code 'toolu_' ids or OpenCode part ids)

reason.description: Denial reason as reported by the harness

error.description: An error surfaced during the session (API error, tool failure, abort)

message.description: Error text as recorded in the transcript

at.description: Timestamp of the transcript record carrying the error

toolName.description: Tool whose call failed, when the error came from a tool result
